context: After a stack is read, each card has a price. The directions differ on when it goes public. C1 and C2 make a draft of each card and list the stack with one press. C3 lists each sure card as soon as it is read and priced. A card is sure only when its name, printing and price all pass the app's checks; everything else stays a draft. All screens, both Duo poses and themes: designs/d4-banchi-phone-v2/phone-blind-1.html (open one with #s=c3-full) and its notes on the roadmap branch. All cards, orders and buyers are made up. Unmeasured: the unfolded Duo height and insets and the folded top inset (drawn 644 pt).

options.gain: You see the stack before anything goes public.
options.how: Cards are drafts until you press List (C1 picture: "List 184 cards").
options.label: One press lists the stack
options.lose: One more step; a stack can stay as drafts if you forget.

options.how: No press (C3 picture: "184 listed this stack").
options.label: Each sure card lists as it is read
options.lose: A wrong price is public for a short time.
